en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a large, elegant villa with a symmetrical façade, multiple windows with shutters, and a central entrance. In front of the villa is a formal Italian garden with geometric beds, paths, a central fountain, and stairs leading down to a gate in the foreground. Handwritten-style text at the bottom identifies the location and building, and a small printed credit appears beneath the image.
